serviceEnvelope.note: corner, wall-front, wall-corner, drop-corner ...: no duration or repeat count given, so checked as applied once, briefly, at room temperature. As delivered the material data puts the limits at: held about 0 h; applied about 1 times (each alone, at a safety factor of 1; measured data). Give the case `hours`, `cycles` or `temperature` to design for its real service; serviceEnvelope.trade lists what each life costs.

failure.compressionSource: nylons and polypropylene yield 1.1-1.3x higher in compression (pressure-dependent yield); low end for printed parts

layers.note: no build direction given, so the layer bonds were not checked and the safety factor 0.49 is the solid material's. pa12 is printed in layers (sls: bonds about 90% of the in-plane strength): built along x the bonds would hold 0.27x the loads, along z 0.40x. Give the study process.buildDirection (or 'auto') to design for it.
